7011671.name: Chabad of Guadalajara
7011671.note: Its listing was remade on 2025-09-10, but it keeps its first listing's old center number (mosad-id 8935), which falls between listings that went up on 2010-12-23 (8910, The Shul of Bellaire) and 2011-01-21 (8956, Anshei Lubavitch, Fair Lawn): so its first chabad.org listing went up about January 2011. Its site jabadmx.com has a page made then (chabad.org article 1420832, Jan 2011). 'Rabbi Abraham Srugo is leader of the Chabad of Guadalajara movement'; he 'lived for a brief time in Mexico City where his father was a Rabbi 30 years ago' (Guadalajara Reporter, published 6 July 2012); Rabbi Abraham and Elisheva Srugo co-directors (Chabad.org, Dec 2016). Fallback (owner, Nov 11: 'I guess they can be low but obviously it must be noted'): no source found for its start, so the year is the one its chabad.org listing went up (about January 2011), entered as LOW. Checked first on the 685 centers with a high-confidence year and a listing made after July 2004: 71% were listed the year they began, 79% within a year.

6342563.name: Chabad of Bosques
6342563.note: No dated source found yet (Nov 2026 searches in English, Spanish and Hebrew). Rabbi Yosef Y. Mayzlesh, its director, was 'director of Chabad in Mexico' in 2018 (Pulse News Mexico). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2024-02-28 and Chabad Lubavitch Mexico City's (his son's) on 2023-12-26, though that one was running by 2018: the family's centers were listed late, so the listing-year fallback is not used here.

6260059.name: Chabad Lubavitch Mexico City
6260059.note: No start year found (Nov 2026 searches in English, Spanish and Hebrew; the family name is also spelled Meislish). By Aug 2018 it was running: Chabad-Lubavitch opened Mexico's first yeshiva on 26 Aug 2018 'under the direction of Rabbi Mendel Mayzlesh, son of Rabbi Yossef Mayzlesh, director of Chabad in Mexico' (Pulse News Mexico, 2 Sept 2018). Its site says only 'Founded in the mid-20th century' (chabadofmexico.com). Its chabad.org listing (Calderon de la Barca 339, Polanco) went up on 2023-12-26, after it was running, so the listing-year fallback is not used. Not in lubavitch.com's Mexico directory of Aug 2011 (Tijuana and Cancun only).
